content.text: In Zimbabwe, a country plagued by crippling currency collapses and international payment restrictions, digital creators are forced to abandon Stripe and PayPal for selling ebooks, courses, and other digital products. This leaves them with limited options for delivering and processing payments, making it nearly impossible to monetize their work. COREMERCH aims to bridge this gap with a sovereign digital commerce stack that empowers creators with full infrastructure ownership and control.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Cloudflare R2 is a highly scalable and secure object storage solution that allows digital creators to store and deliver their products without relying on third-party platforms like Gumroad or Payhip. By integrating R2 with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, creators can automate the delivery of digital products, ensuring a seamless user experience. This is a game-changer for those who want to monetize their digital work without the burden of platform fees or restrictions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The Edge Commerce Stack, a COREMERCH product, combines Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments to create a comprehensive digital commerce solution. Cloudflare Pages hosts the website, while Cloudflare Workers automates delivery and processing. Supabase handles order storage, and NOWPayments provides automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This architecture ensures fast and secure digital product delivery, all without relying on Stripe or PayPal.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives or delivered via hosted video links, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase. Both approaches work reliably and cost nothing beyond the storage used.
Automating delivery and processing with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script is key to a seamless user experience.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Cloudflare R2 provides secure object storage, while Cloudflare Workers automates delivery and processing. Supabase handles order storage, and NOWPayments provides automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Google Apps Script can also be used to automate delivery and processing, offering flexibility and customization options for creators. By combining these components, creators can build a comprehensive digital commerce solution that meets their unique needs.
